title: broadcom-dnx: warning message, "image you're trying to install is of a different ASIC type"
author: jon-nokia

#### Description
Warning message during sonic-installer or onie-nos-install, “The image you're trying to install is of a different ASIC type as the running platform's ASIC.  Do you still wish to install this image? [y/n]” 

Root Cause:
Recall when building an image with PLATFORM=broadcom, two images are built
 - sonic-broadcom.bin
 - sonic-broadcom-dnx.bin

device/**/platform_asic files indicate which ASIC are supported

The DNX build continues to use PLATFORM=broadcom, however the device/**/platform_asic files advertise “broadcom-dnx” for those devices that support DNX (instead of XGS).  This confuses the build_image.sh:generate_device_list() function and prevents it from generating the list of supported platforms for the configured build,  instead, installer/$TARGET_PLATFORM/platforms_asic lists only XGS platforms and the subsequent grep, which uses "-x, --line-regexp" option will not match those platform_asic files that contain "broadcom-dnx"

Not sure if we should remove grep "-x" option or solve in some other manner.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Build image for PLATFORM=broadcom
2. Attempt to install the sonic-broadcom-dnx.bin
3.

Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9759
#### Why I did it
`sonic-broadcom-dnx.bin` should be able to installed on DNX supported platform, whereas it doesn't.
#### How I did it
Changed `CONFIGUTED_PLATFORM` to `TARGET_MACHINE` to distinguish `broadcom` and `broadcom-dnx`
#### How to verify it
tar `sonic-broadcom-dnx.bin` and verify its `platforms_asic` contians dnx platforms
